text:
ashwin: spotted a weird spike — ~60 small GPU pods started getting preempted in ap-southeast1a/b around 10:03 UTC. eviction spam and backfill. any ideas?
maria: saw that too, dashboards show GPU pool free capacity at 0 and pending nodes in the ASG. ASG not supplying new racks fast enough.
jonathan: why is the ASG not scaling? spot instance reqs are high — possible launch failures? I see ENI attach timeouts in the launch logs.
infra-bot: ASG event: desired=18 actual=12. Recent constraint: rack-reserve affinity prevented node selection in ap-southeast1b.
ashwin: (typo) meant ashwin ^^
ashwin: also saw a bunch of failed liveness probes -> conntrack saturation on nodes, kubelet started evicting pods. snippet:
```
Jun 21 10:03:05 node-az1 kubelet: failed to POST /healthz: dial tcp x.x.x.x:10250: i/o timeout
netstat -s | grep conntrack: nf_conntrack: table full
```
kevin: conntrack full would explain probe failures. Did a kube-proxy change alter conntrack hashsize recently?
maria: no config rollouts for kube-proxy. There was a burst from the eval harness — lots of short-lived gRPC connections. Combined with ASG delay, nodes got overloaded.
tasha: suggestion: temporarily increase net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max on affected nodes and taint the warmpool to repel small fractional pods.
jonathan: agree. Also we should loosen scheduler preemption for tiny pods to avoid cascade evictions. Maybe lower preemptiveness for fractional-gpu-request < 0.5.
nashwin: (typo) ashwin again. Plan: 1) bump conntrack via daemonset 2) patch ASG launch template to prefer on-demand warm nodes 3) taint gpu-warmpool to keep tiny pods out 4) rolling restart kube-proxy. Who can own step 1 & 4?
kevin: I'll push a quick daemonset to bump nf_conntrack_max + sysctl and trigger kube-proxy restart via a small rollout (kube-system). Doing now.
maria: I'll open an incident page and ping cloud infra about spot feed errors and AZ affinity issues. Also scaling up on-demand by +4 until resupply stabilizes.
jonathan: I'll draft a scheduler PR to reduce preemption pressure for small fractional pods. Putting link in thread when ready.
nashwin: also can we add an admission hint for packing: prefer-full-gpu for jobs with label `pack=prefer-full` — stopgap to reduce fragmentation.
tasha: ack. I'll prepare the taint for warmpool: `kubectl taint nodes -l pool=warm gpu-frag=true:NoSchedule` and add tolerations to full-gang workloads.
maria: incident: https://incidents.redwood/INC-3421 (initial triage + mitigation actions).
infra-bot: ASG event cleared at 10:26 UTC — desired=22 actual=22, recent launches successful.
nashwin: evictions subsided after conntrack bump + extra on-demand nodes. Follow-ups: capacity smoothing (warmpool sizing), conntrack baseline on GPU nodes, scheduler admission for pack-hints, and a short-term policy for preemption on fractional pods.
kevin: created tickets INFRA-789 (conntrack baseline) and SCHED-456 (preempt policy tuning).
maria: thanks everyone. leaving the follow-ups in tickets, closing out here unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
